scope: Complete4,834-frame Dev screen, not Test. Single-lag geometric point transport and multi-lag/co-visible memory controls. Ordinary point tracking and generic memory are not by themselves new multimodal contributions.

diagnosis.scope: Proposal-level IoU Hungarian GT mapping after independent point extraction; not official IDSW/HOTA or a tracking result. No GT input to runtime. Single-anchor confidence ignores reciprocal competition and multi-history averaging, so this diagnoses raw evidence rather than predicting final decisions.
